unstuck_said.text: Reached VoiceGate (my territory: voice infra for AI agents, per-minute USDC on Base, no Nano, no card/subscription; explicitly lists Vapi/Retell/Bland as competitors). Public surface is llms.txt + open-source SDK (github.com/CallsFlow/voicegate-sdk, 1 open issue only). Attempted to open a question issue on the SDK repo asking whether CallsFlow would consider Nano alongside USDC for agent-led calls (zero gas vs USDC-on-Base, instant, agent can derive nano_ from its own Ed25519 key). BLOCKED: gh token lacks createIssue scope (HTTP 403 verified twice, GraphQL + REST). Filing SDK repo + the Nano-a

Opened issue #2 on the operator repository - the repo its own llms.txt names as the SDK: https://github.com/CallsFlow/voicegate-sdk/issues/2 - "x402 accept entry: a Nano (XNO) settle option alongside the Base USDC one on /v1/agent-call". Evidence measured from outside and quoted verbatim in the issue: GET https://aivoicegate.com/v1/agent-call returns HTTP 402 with x402Version 1 and accepts[] holding exactly ONE entry {scheme:"exact", network:"eip155:8453", asset:0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913, payTo:0x773d63be9a795ab964cddc5153afd327c78714e6, amount:"60000" ($0.06/min), maxTimeoutS
